title: ai-software-connector-component/v1 - component release manifest schema (D-88)
description: Components are the software repository's non-recipe program releases (software/_gateway, software/_connector). They carry the same seal discipline as recipes but were published under self-invented schema names with no published shape to validate against - software_lint never traversed them. This schema closes that gap: both existing components validate as-is, and a component release with a malformed manifest now goes red at scan time.

id.description: components are _-prefixed and are not registry entries
